purpose: Teach: 角栄/野茂/バチカン/アーセナル/レオナルド/コスタリカ/苫小牧/クウェート

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが田中角栄首相の時代を語られた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Dad used to talk about the Kakuei Tanaka era…
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Gentle cadence. Reaching back into memory. Pause after 'Gran'—inviting her in. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、野茂英雄の活躍に喜ばれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear—Grandpa was so pleased when Hideo Nomo was pitching, wasn't he?
lines.style: Warm, lived-in tone. She's checking the memory with him, not correcting. Slight lift on 'wasn't he'—inviting agreement. Gentle reassurance beneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがバチカン市国を訪問された
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Dad visited Vatican City…
lines.style: Same wistful register. Slightly more formal memory. Voice settles lower. Gentle reach across time. Softer attack on the memory itself.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、アーセナルの試合をご覧になってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And Grandpa, you used to watch the Arsenal matches, remember?
lines.style: Playful redirection. Softer 'and'—she's caught onto the rhythm now. Warm smile in the voice. Tender tease. The 'remember' is affectionate, not testing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがレオナルド研究の本をご愛読された
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Dad loved reading about Leonardo's research…
lines.style: Returns to wistfulness. Quieter than before. A thread of something uncertain—he's reaching, remembering. Held breath. Slow unwinding.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、コスタリカの平和主義を尊敬されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You really respected Costa Rica's peaceful approach to things, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm knowing. She's teasing gently now, calling him out with affection. Slight lilt of humor. The 'didn't you' is almost conspiratorial—we both know this about you.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが苫小牧の親戚を訪ねられた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Dad used to visit the relatives in Tomakomai…
lines.style: Wistful but more grounded. Less ethereal. A specific, real memory surfacing. Measured pace. Steadier breath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、クウェート侵攻のニュースに憤慨されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And Grandpa, you were so upset when you heard about the invasion of Kuwait…
lines.style: Softer than before, more knowing. A gentle close to the dance. She's ending with something real—his anger, his humanity. Warm, final. Fades gently.
